materials.quote: The parts were produced of the nickel-based superalloy IN718 on two different PBF-LB/M machines.

extracted_parameters.quote: While the Overheating build job was manufactured on the first PBF-LB/M machine (M280, EOS GmbH, Germany), the remaining build jobs were conducted on the second PBF-LB/M machine (M290, EOS GmbH, Germany).

While the Overheating build job was manufactured on the first PBF-LB/M machine (M280, EOS GmbH, Germany), the remaining build jobs were conducted on the second PBF-LB/M machine (M290, EOS GmbH, Germany).
The parts were processed under an inert gas atmosphere using Argon.
The build plate preheating temperature was set to 353.15 K.

Each layer, with a height of 40 µm, of the build jobs was monitored by an OT system (EOSTATE Exposure OT, EOS GmbH, Germany) with a total pixel distribution of 2050 × 2050 px (M280) and 2000 × 2000 px (M290).
The parts were manufactured with laser powers of 90%, 100%, and 110%, with 100% corresponding to the standard laser power.

extracted_parameters.quote: The parts on the build plate were manufactured with differing laser powers, ranging from 80% to 108% in steps of 4%, where 100% corresponded to the standard parameter set.

Besides the standard laser power, modified laser powers with decreased values of 80% (part Image 1008), increased values of 104% (part Image 1009), and medium values of 88% (part Image 1010) were captured with a similar precision, as the difference images indicate.
